q: Deadlock hone ke liye kitni conditions ek saath honi chahiye?
explain: Chaar Coffman conditions ek saath chahiye: mutual exclusion, hold and wait, no preemption, circular wait.

q: Banker's algorithm kis category mein aata hai?
explain: Banker's algorithm deadlock avoidance hai: har allocation se pehle check karta hai ki system safe state mein rahega ya nahi.

q: Single-instance resources wale Resource Allocation Graph mein cycle ka matlab kya hai?
options: Deadlock ho sakta hai, par zaroori nahi
explain: Jab har resource type ka ek hi instance ho, graph mein cycle ka matlab pakka deadlock. Multiple instances par cycle se deadlock possible hai par zaroori nahi.

q: Diye gaye example mein Available = (3 3 2). Kaunsa process safe sequence mein sabse pehle chal sakta hai?
explain: Sirf P1 ka Need (1 2 2) Available (3 3 2) se chhota ya barabar hai, isliye safe sequence P1 se shuru hota hai.

q: Circular wait condition ko todne ka sabse practical tarika kya hai?
options: Saare resources shuru mein hi de dena
Resources ko number dekar sirf badhte order mein request karna
explain: Har resource ko ek number dekar sabhi processes ko badhte number ke order mein hi request karne dena circular wait ko tod deta hai.
